eras.source: Idaho Citizen Commission for Reapportionment (Plan L03)
eras.note: Idaho uses one unified map: all 35 legislative districts elect 1 Senator and 2 Representatives from identical boundaries. Four legal challenges to the map were rejected by the Idaho Supreme Court in January 2022. Veto override is 2/3 of members present, not full elected membership — the seat figure here assumes full attendance.
